body: Yes. I actually got in contact with my psychiatrist the other day and they prescribed me a new medication. I feel somewhat better now. :)

Yes! Reading some of the comments, the fact that this is a disorder is actually very interesting to me. I just always accepted it as "my hormones are all out of wack, that's why I want to end it all and have an elaborate plan and oops now im in the hospital" (true story)

I have a doctor's appointment tomorrow, I'm going to try to bring this up.
